name: Hal Saflieni Hypogeum — Main Chamber

acoustics.description: The chamber resonates strongly at 110 Hz — the low male chant frequency. Standing waves reinforce at this frequency with a measured RT60 of ~8 seconds.
acoustics.effect_on_occupants: At 110 Hz, the acoustic resonance shifts brain activity from left-hemisphere (language, logic) to right-hemisphere (ritual, spatial). Measured EEG effects reported by multiple researchers.
acoustics.notes: The 'Oracle Chamber' has a carved aperture that focuses 110 Hz into the main hall. Infrasound at 18-19 Hz creates dread and visual phenomena.

references: Cook, I.A. et al. (2008). Ancient acoustic resonance and the brain. Time and Mind.
Reznikoff, I. (2002). Palaeolithic cave art and acoustic resonance. JASA.
Lubman, D. (2002). Ancient acoustic spaces. JASA.
